caption.SceneDescription: The video captures a view from a boat moving along a canal in Amsterdam on a bright, sunny day. The sky is a clear, deep blue. On the right bank, a row of traditional Dutch canal houses with distinctive stepped and bell-shaped gables lines the water. In the immediate foreground, a long, rectangular houseboat with white curtains and a red door floats on the water. To the left, modern apartment buildings and parked bicycles are visible along the quay. The water is calm with gentle ripples reflecting the sunlight. The camera tracks forward smoothly, passing the houseboat and revealing more of the canal and the buildings behind it.

editmeta.edit_instruction_1: Change the lighting in the scene from bright midday sun to a warm, golden sunset, transitioning the sky from blue to a glowing orange and yellow hue, making the sunlight low and directional to cast long shadows and bathe the buildings and water in a rich, amber glow, and altering the reflections on the water from bright white highlights to deep golden streaks.
editmeta.edit_instruction_2: Transform the long rectangular houseboat into a lush floating garden covered with small trees, dense green shrubs, and bright tulips, retaining its position on the canal beneath the existing golden sunset.
editmeta.edit_instruction_3: Change the golden sunset into a deep star-filled night, adding hundreds of green fireflies throughout the existing floating garden and shimmering reflections across the dark canal beneath the illuminated houses.
